description_en: Cancels or interrupts a specified conversation
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot cancel-chat --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --session-id c1187530338311ebade7cf3eaeb3668a --chat-id 7105a351-b2e7-4c9e-8437-c43a043c0a4e --instance-id chatbot-cn-yjzbyrEvqd --type Canceled --answer '这个答案被打' --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelChat

parameters.help_en: The business space key. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: The session ID, which is used to identify a visitor's session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to specify this parameter when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId in the response of the Chat operation. For subsequent conversation turns of the visitor, pass the SessionId of the current session when calling the Chat operation so that the chatbot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId. Maximum length: 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于标识一个访问者的会话和保持上下文信息。对于一个新的访问者，首次调用Chat接口时无需传递此字段，机器人会开启一个会话，并在Chat接口的响应中返回该会话的SessionId。对于该访问者的后续轮次的会话，调用Chat接口时传递当前会话的SessionId，机器人即可基于SessionId继续该轮次会话。长度限制是64个字符
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The ID that identifies a single conversation
parameters.name: chat_id
